extractions.extraction_text: Table 1 provides reduction factors for the mechanical properties of steel (reinforcing and prestressing) based on temperature, to be used in the simplified 500-isotherm method for calculating the fire resistance of reinforced concrete structures.

attributes.Procedure: To determine the reduced mechanical characteristics of steel in reinforced concrete structures under fire conditions using the simplified 500-isotherm method, consult Table 1. The table provides reduction factors for different types of steel (hot-rolled reinforcing steel, cold-drawn reinforcing steel, cold-drawn prestressing steel, and quenched and tempered prestressing steel) at various temperatures (100°C to 1200°C). Multiply the original mechanical property by the corresponding reduction factor from the table.
